frontend_requirements: The frontend must allow users to view available movies, select seats on a seating plan, and complete payments securely.
backend_requirements: The backend must handle movie management, seat selection, payment processing, and user authentication using secure APIs.
a2a_ocl_constraints: context Payment inv: self.transaction_status = 'completed' implies self.user.payment_info->size() > 0
context Authentication inv: self.user.role != 'guest' implies self.sessions->size() > 0
mermaid_syntax: graph TD; A[User]-->B[Movie Service]; B-->C[Seat Selection Service]; C-->D[Payment Service]; D-->C; C-->E[Update Seat Availability]; A-->F[Authentication Service];
